name: Textarea

props.note: On the exposed Label row instance. Figma holds text only; web code can also take elements.

props.figmaDefault: Shown on the public tournament page.
props.note: On the exposed Hint instance. Needs showHint on. Shown above the control, as in code.
Same name, different trigger. Figma shows the text when state=invalid; in code, setting error makes the field invalid.
Code takes any number; Figma has 3 and 5. Resize the Control frame for other heights.
Behaviour. Show the grown height by resizing the Control frame.
Web only. The drag handle is not drawn in Figma.
Figma holds the counter text ("86 / 500"); code derives it from the value length and maxLength. Needs showCount on.
On the exposed Label row instance. Shows the asterisk.
On the exposed Label row instance.

props.figmaDefault: Open to all skill levels. Cash payouts in advanced divisions, trophies for all.
props.note: Figma value is sample text for the filled and invalid states. There is no controlled / uncontrolled split.
disabled=true in code is state=disabled in Figma.
The standard textarea placeholder attribute in code. It is passed through, so the spec does not list it.
Figma-only axis for specs and prototypes. invalid comes from the error prop, disabled from the disabled prop. near limit is shown with showCount and a count close to the limit.

purpose: Multi-line text entry for free text longer than a line (descriptions, notes, comments), with the same label, hint, error and counter wiring as InputField.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Placeholders are not labels.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Visually hide the label (keeps the accessible name).

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance about what to write, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; sets aria-invalid. Say how to fix it.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible lines before scrolling (the minimum height when autoGrow is on).

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grow with the content up to maxRows, then scroll.

props.name: resize
props.description: Whether the user can drag to resize. Ignored when autoGrow is on.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Hard character limit. Pair with showCount so people can see it.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show a “86 / 500” counter under the field. Needs maxLength.

props.name: showOptional
props.description: Show '(optional)' instead; use when most fields are required.

states.name: default
states.description: border.strong outline, rows × line height tall.

states.name: focus
states.description: Focus ring + border.selected on the control.

states.name: filled
states.description: Has a value; counter shows the length when showCount is on.

states.name: near limit
states.description: Within 10% of maxLength: counter turns text.warning and is announced once.

states.name: invalid
states.description: 2px border.danger, error message with icon below.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled background and text; not resizable.

tokens.usage: Gap between label, control, hint and counter.
Entered text: 16px minimum prevents iOS zoom.
Line height used to size rows / maxRows.

keyboard.action: Inserts a new line. It never submits the form.
Not handled by Textarea; a form may opt in to submit with it.

screenReader: Announces label, required state, “multi-line”, value, then hint, counter and error via aria-describedby.
The counter is not a live region on every keystroke. A polite live region announces “20 characters left” once when the 10% threshold is crossed and “Character limit reached” at the limit.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the whole control (focus-within), same as InputField.
accessibility.touchTarget: At least 44px tall on touch (rows ≥ 2 always exceeds it).
notes: Validate on blur or submit, not on every keystroke.
If maxLength is set, say the limit in the hint or show the counter; silently blocking typing fails 3.3.2.
Keep the resize handle at least 24×24 and don't remove it unless autoGrow is on.

variants.name: with counter
variants.useWhen: Text has a real limit (public descriptions, SMS-length notes).

variants.name: auto-grow
variants.description: Grows from rows to maxRows, then scrolls.
variants.useWhen: Comments and notes where length varies a lot.

do: Use Textarea when answers are usually longer than one line; use InputField otherwise.
Size rows to the expected answer (3 for a short description, 5–6 for notes).
Show the limit with showCount whenever maxLength is set.
dont: Don't use the placeholder as the label or as the only instructions.
Don't make Enter submit the form.
Don't disable resize on a fixed-height field that people may need to read back.

related.name: InputField
related.reason: Single-line text; shares the field chrome.

related.name: Select
related.reason: Choosing from predefined values instead of writing them.

example.web:
<Textarea label="Description" showOptional hint="Shown on the public tournament page." rows={3} maxLength={500} showCount />
<Textarea label="Match notes" autoGrow maxRows={6} error={errors.notes} />
